newsitem.title: USA: Dow retraces some lost ground, tech stocks mixed.
newsitem.headline: Dow retraces some lost ground, tech stocks mixed.

text.p: U.S. blue chips moved higher after the market open on Thursday, recouping after yesterday's slide, and technology stocks were slightly firmer after a mixed session start.
The Dow Jones Industrial Average tacked on a swift 36 points, or 0.46 percent, to 7878.
The Nasdaq composite, which rose on Wednesday despite a slump in the Dow, gained around two points to trade at 1488.
The long bond was off 4/32 at a 6.58 percent yield.

"Earnings are starting to come in and so far today, they've been okay," Charles White, managing director at Avatar Associates, said. "Yesterday's dramatic decline was something of an exaggeration. You get a lot of action from the program traders, and this is a bounceback."
Dow component General Electric Corp reported second quarter earnings of $0.66 per share compared with $0.58 per share in the year-ago quarter.
The First Call consensus estimate was $0.65 per share.
J.P. Morgan posted second quarter earnings of $1.85 per share compared with $2.14 per share in the year-ago period.
